features.nameEn: Bulk edit, trash, and status operations
features.notes: Site and global post/page bulk status/trash workflows now include multi-select UX, per-site grouping, ownership preflight, a 100-item safety limit, destructive confirmation in global explorers, Execution Center jobs, and automated policy verification; Build #1133 and .NET Build Verification #894 passed.

Production media workflow now includes server-side upload validation, live metadata/accessibility optimization, reviewable AI alt text, modified_gmt conflict protection, confirmed permanent deletion, tenant-safe media API routes, and local-cache reconciliation without advancing the sync watermark. Binary recompression/resizing/transcoding is intentionally not claimed; Build #1153 and .NET Build Verification #898 passed.

Pre-sync local-vs-live review detects remote updates/deletions, reports additions separately, blocks cache replacement until conflicts are reviewed, supports transient defer/manual editor merge, and provides confirmed Accept WordPress via forced full refresh. The SQLite cache remains a read mirror and is never posted back as stale content; Build #1171 and .NET Build Verification #904 passed.
